description:
Land mapped for environmental protection near the property: protected-plant
and wetland mapping, environmentally sensitive land, scenic protection land and
conservation areas. Says whether one covers the address point, how far the
nearest is, and how many lie within 1 km. Held mostly for Queensland, with some
areas of NSW.

**Price: 3¢ per call.**
